items.text: How do residents, faculty assessors, chief residents and programme administrators in one internal medicine residency experience the workload of EPA assessment, and what do they see as the reasons for late, brief or strategically chosen assessments?
items.population: Residents in training years 1 to 3, faculty assessors, chief residents and programme administrators
items.intervention: Experience of the app-based EPA assessment system with a target of 12 per rotation
items.outcome: Themes on workload, purpose and reasons for late, brief or strategic assessment

finer: Feasible with a 0.2 FTE research assistant and approved half-day time; interesting to the competency committee; novel locally and across roles; ethical with approval REB-2026-0412 and interviews by a person without a progression role; relevant because the targets will be revised in June.
summary: One SPIDER question across four roles.
